en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a lakeside rural complex in a forested landscape. Several wooden buildings with pitched roofs are scattered among tall coniferous trees, connected by curved dirt roads. There is an open grass field near the shoreline and farmland visible in the background. The architecture suggests a Nordic countryside resort, camp, or institutional compound.
